comment: macOS shell pitfalls: GNU-only forms that fail on macOS (must deny, naming the form that works) and look-alikes (must allow). Matched on the raw text, line by line, as the earlier shell script did.

deny.name: GNU timeout on a later line

allow.name: the Bash tool's timeout parameter is no command
timeout without a number
allow.command: echo timeout is set in config

allow.name: timeout and its number on separate lines
